description: Review-context projection of accepted 20261025T214055Z export and stale reviewer finding; not a complete or approved specification.

A_CLOCK.statement: clk continues to provide rising edges while rst_n is low so synchronous reset state clearing can occur.

A_HOST_STALL.statement: The host holds txn_valid and all transaction payload fields stable while txn_valid is high and txn_ready is low.

A_PROFILE.statement: The selected timing library supplies the declared DDR4-3200 timing paths.

A_PROGRESS.statement: Service progress requires reset to remain inactive and timing and refresh intervals to elapse; no bounded transaction latency is asserted.

A_RESPONSE.statement: The host samples every rsp_valid pulse because no response-backpressure interface is provided.

Q_PROFILE_PROVENANCE.question: The authoritative provenance and acceptance of the selected DDR4-3200 timing-library source requires external review before RTL generation; planned timing-boundary checks cannot establish library correctness.

Q_RTL_APPROVAL.question: Approval of this exact draft package is required before RTL generation or downstream implementation export.

historical_finding.message: The host_adapter response outputs are declared and driven from memory response storage, but the structural graph has no connections from host_adapter.rsp_valid and host_adapter.rsp_rdata to top.rsp_valid and top.rsp_rdata. The recorded architecture validation also identifies those top sinks as undriven and the adapter outputs as unused. Consequently, committed READ responses cannot reach the required host-visible response ports, and response-delivery bindings at the top cannot distinguish the claimed behavior. Add the missing structural top-level response connections and rerun architecture validation.
